Cedar Rock Capital LTD Raised Its Position in Clorox Co Del (CLX) by $1.20 Million as Stock Declined; As Assured Guaranty LTD (Put) (AGO) Market Value Rose, Holder Holowesko Partners LTD Has Boosted Holding
June 16, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Andy Brown increased its stake in Clorox Co Del (CLX) by 0.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cedar Rock Capital Ltd bought 9,001 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.80% with the market. The hedge fund run by Andy Brown held 2.48 million shares of the specialty chemicals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $330.54 million, up from 2.47M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cedar Rock Capital Ltd who had been investing in Clorox Co Del for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.69 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.75% or $0.96 during the last trading session, reaching $128.85. About 1.89M shares traded or 39.07% up from the average. The Clorox Company (NYSE:CLX) has declined 9.29% since June 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.86% the S&P500.
